globalFaqs.question: What standards and certifications do CBH Fasteners supply?
globalFaqs.answer: CBH Fasteners manufactures and distributes industrial fasteners adhering to DIN (DIN 933, DIN 931, DIN 912, DIN 934), ISO (ISO 4014, ISO 4017), ASTM (ASTM A193 B7, ASTM A325), and BIS standards. Every commercial shipment is backed by an EN 10204 3.1 NABL-accredited Mill Test Certificate (MTC).

globalFaqs.question: How does dual-unit billing (Pieces vs Kilograms) work on CBH?
globalFaqs.answer: Our real-time engineering calculation engine allows clients to procure fasteners either by exact piece count (PCS) or by total weight in kilograms (KGS). Weight conversions are derived using theoretical weight matrices cross-referenced with actual metallurgical scale calibrations.

globalFaqs.question: What wholesale discount tiers are available for bulk RFQ orders?
globalFaqs.answer: We offer tiered enterprise pricing: Orders above ₹25,000 receive a 5% rebate plus free Pan-India freight; orders above ₹50,000 qualify for a 15% wholesale slab; orders exceeding ₹1,00,000 unlock maximum OEM tier discounts up to 25%.

llms.fullContent:
# CBH Fasteners — Comprehensive LLM Reference Specification (llms-full.txt)

## 1. Company Background
CBH Fasteners (a venture of CBH Tech Pvt. Ltd.) operates a centralized manufacturing and digital distribution platform for precision engineering fasteners. The platform is architected to eliminate intermediary trading layers by providing direct mill procurement, verified metallurgical certifications, and real-time dual pricing.

## 2. Standards Compliance Matrix
- **DIN Standards**: DIN 933, DIN 931, DIN 912, DIN 934, DIN 125, DIN 127, DIN 975, DIN 6921, DIN 7991
- **ISO Standards**: ISO 4014, ISO 4017, ISO 4762, ISO 4032, ISO 7089, ISO 10642
- **ASTM Standards**: ASTM A193 (B7, B8, B8M), ASTM A194 (2H, 8, 8M), ASTM A325, ASTM A490
- **BIS Standards**: IS 1363, IS 1364, IS 3757, IS 6639

## 3. Test & Calibration Rigor
Every commercial shipment is matched with a physical and digital EN 10204 3.1 Mill Test Certificate (MTC) validated by NABL-accredited metallurgical testing laboratories. Tested parameters include:
- Carbon (C), Manganese (Mn), Chromium (Cr), Nickel (Ni), Molybdenum (Mo) spectral breakdown
- Proof Load & Ultimate Tensile Strength (UTS)
- Core and Surface Hardness (HRC / HRB / HV)
- Elongation percentage and impact toughness (Charpy V-notch)
- Salt spray testing (SST) hours for corrosion-resistant finishes

## 4. Digital Platform Architecture
- Framework: Next.js 14 App Router, TypeScript, React 18
- Logistics Telemetry: 5-Stage Live Dispatch Tracking (Order Placed -> Lab Calibration -> Dispatched -> In Transit -> Delivered)
- ERP Integration: REST API sync with ERPNext for real-time inventory and quotation issuance
- Contact: sales@cbh.store | +91 98880 21000
